sentences.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
sentences.zh: 有时候曲棍球运动员会因为竞争太激烈而打起来。

sentences.en: We won hands down, because the other players were weak.
sentences.zh: 我们轻松获胜，因为对方选手实力较弱。

sentences.en: The player won the championship three times in a row.
sentences.zh: 那个选手连续三年赢得了冠军。

senses.zh: 运动员，选手；演奏者，表演者；玩家；参与者；播放器；花花公子；演员；重要人物
